title.narrative: Global Quality and Standards Programme - Viet Nam

description.narrative: The Global Quality and Standards Programme is a strategic partnership between Switzerland and UNIDO to promote trade and competitiveness through strengthening the quality and standards compliance capacity to facilitate markets for SMEs in eight priority countries. GQSP country project in Vietnam focuses on #increasing quality and standards compliance capacity of Mango value chain in Mekong River Delta#. To achieve this the Project will pursue the following three outcomes: # Technical competence and sustainability of the Quality Infrastructure System and conformity assessment services related to export mango value chains enhanced # Mango export value chain compliant with quality and standards requirements of target export markets. # Improved culture of quality for enabling access of mango producers to high-quality ex-port markets.
